text: This is my cat, Biscuit. She's asleep. Again.
Asleep on the sofa. Asleep in the sun. Asleep in my sock drawer!
Cats sleep about twelve to sixteen hours a day.
sub: Cats sleep about 12 to 16 hours a day.

text: That's half the day, or even more!
Why so sleepy? Long ago, wild cats had to hunt for every meal.
Running and pouncing takes lots of energy.
So cats rest a lot, and save it for the big moments.
Most cat naps are light. Even asleep, her ears keep listening.
Cats are busiest at sunrise and sunset. Like right now!
And when the stars come out...
Scientists think cats might even dream.
